notes.title: Demo Update 3.0
notes.content: [p]Demo Version 3[/p][p]- Minor typo fixes[/p][p]- Rebalanced \[spoiler]Cygnus\[/spoiler] battle[/p][p]- Updated the mechanics for all status effects[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused Refined Aether to only heal one party member[/p][p]- Characters now start with 6 battle skill slots[/p][p]- Balance adjustments[/p]

notes.title: Version 2.6
notes.content:
- Fixed a visual bug in Heaven's Gate that described the wrong orb being picked up
- Fixed a visual bug that prevented Battle Points from appearing during The Gauntlet
- Fixed a bug that allowed Janus and Judge to learned special skills twice
- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to carry an extra orb in Heaven's Gate
- The tavern in Beacon Hill no longer sells two heckin' Tents
- Balance adjustments for all enemies in Heaven's Gate
- Updated encounters mechanic on the overworld

notes.title: Version 2.5
notes.content: [p]- Updated cutscene after completing Crescent Lake[/p][p]- Balance adjustments to Crimson Keep intro[/p][p]- Updated descriptions for some weapons[/p][p]- Fixed a bug in Gehenna Caverns that transferred the player into a heckin' wall[/p][p]- Fixed a bug in Gehenna Cavern's that respawned the Fallen Star in the wrong location[/p][p]- Fixed a bug in Beacon Hill that caused background music to stop[/p][p]- Fixed a softlock at the entrance to the Tower of Light courtyard[/p][p]- Added weaknesses to Despair and Assent minibosses[/p][p]- Rebalanced offensive items to be consistent with similar skills[/p]

notes.title: Version 2.4
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that let a Gazer run away like a punk
- Rebalanced Melodium Mortis hit rate
- Fixed a bug that played the incorrect battle theme after completing Azure Kingdom
- Fixed a collision issue in Crystal Mines
- Updated Fallen Stars to trigger automatically rather than when engaged
- Fixed visual glitch in the Black Hills
- Changed tonic and aether animations to be consistent with descriptions
- Balance adjustments

notes.title: Version 2.3
notes.content:
- Visual update to the Black Hills
- Fixed a bug that caused mechanics in the Black Hills to only function on certain maps

notes.title: Version 2.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that prevented Divinity from functioning correctly when selected in the main menu
- Paralyze and Falter no longer remove skill costs if triggered

notes.title: Version 2.1
notes.content:
Version 2.1

- Changed weakness icons for consistency with skills
- Mid-game boss fights rebalanced

- Changed layout of Azure Kingdom puzzles to reduce noise
- Added new items, synthesize menu, and hint menu to Azure Kingdom "shop"
- Music cue fixes
- Added helpful dialogue to towns regarding random encounter

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
- Fixed a visual glitch in Crimson Keep
- Added a "Cancel" option to Lodestars

- Added new "Tutorial" menu option

notes.title: Version 1.4

notes.title: Version 1.3 Update
notes.content: - Fixed a bug in the Crimson Keep intro that softlocked the player after returning to the dungeon

notes.title: Bug Reports
notes.content: [p]A new bug report form has been added to the web page for Symphony of the Stars. If you come across a bug, no matter how small, I would appreciate a short submission so that I can fix it! The form can be found at [url="https://www.willardofozstudios.com/symphony-of-the-stars"]https://www.willardofozstudios.com/symphony-of-the-stars[/url]. Any screenshots and videos that help track down exactly what went wrong are appreciated but not necessary. Thanks and I hope you're enjoying the game![/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update

- Balance Adjustments
- Fixed a bug that, after a very specific series of events, caused a softlock in the Frozen Heights
- Godsouls now count as elemental AND physical damage
